subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook mappings support automatic post-failure fallback delivery, and should the public contract be an ordered `fallbackChannels` chain, reuse cron failure destinations, or keep hooks single-target?
rationale: This adds public config and cross-channel delivery semantics; repository policy treats fallback/config additions as compatibility- and product-sensitive, and current code already has adjacent recovery mechanisms with different meanings.

options.title: Add Ordered Hook Fallbacks
options.body: Add a typed ordered fallback list for hook mappings and attempt alternates only after a real primary delivery failure, with privacy, allowlist, and all-targets-failed behavior documented and tested.

options.title: Reuse Failure Destinations
options.body: Model hook failover through the existing cron failure-destination concept if maintainers want one shared failure-routing abstraction instead of a hook-specific field.

options.title: Keep Hooks Single-Target
options.body: Keep hook mappings single-target and document `channel: "last"`, `bestEffort`, and failure notifications as the supported recovery surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add Ordered Hook Fallbacks
recommendation.body: Add a typed ordered fallback list for hook mappings and attempt alternates only after a real primary delivery failure, with privacy, allowlist, and all-targets-failed behavior documented and tested.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current issue-review signal and recent hook/config surface history.
